description: Resettlement of unauthorized dwellers affected by the land acquisition process for the construction of the Baseline Road Extension Project               Phase-III
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A committee chaired by the Divisional Secretary, Thimbirigasyaya has been appointed to provide houses to unauthorized families displaced due to the land acquisition process for the implementation of Phase III of the Baseline Road Extension Project. Based on the recommendations submitted by the said Committee, houses have been granted to 29 displaced family units as of now under the 'Sarasavi Uyana' housing scheme implemented by the Urban Development Authority. Considering the special circumstances and matters presented during the inspections such as the size of the house to be lost being more than the size of the house to be provided, several sub-families living in the same house at the time of land acquisition, and the presence of unmarried persons with special needs, the committee has recommended that houses be provided to 08 more displaced residents in addition to the 29 family units. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement the said recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.
